stageNotes.stage1_canonicalUrl: Apex returns 200 cleanly; www -> 301 -> apex. link rel=canonical href=https://alflahertys.com/. No hreflang. Canonical = apex.
stageNotes.stage2_waf: 8-batch probe: cf-ray on every response, no challenges. Set hasWaf=false (cloudflare-passive — Stage 2 rule: operational not literal).
stageNotes.stage3_platform: BC Stencil confirmed via 3 signals: meta name=platform value=bigcommerce.stencil, cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-rk4zcah9rr, theme-bundle.polyfills.js. adapterType=generic-retail (validator-accepted, has Klevu branch).
stageNotes.stage4_catalogUrls: Two parallel discovery paths cross-checked: (a) homepage nav extract -> 12 top-level slugs; (b) /xmlsitemap.php?type=categories -> 12 1-segment slugs. Same 12 categories. Category pages confirmed Klevu-rendered (klevuLanding div empty in static HTML, js.klevu.com scripts in footer). Full-walk-and-dedupe deferred: Klevu API wildcard SEARCH totalResultsFound (5262) === xmlsitemap product count (5262) — coverage proof is the count match, since the Klevu adapter at runtime fetches ALL products globally regardless of catalogUrl entry point.
stageNotes.stage5_pagination: Klevu offset+limit API. Page 1 offset=0 product ids [10599,16368,17096]; page 2 offset=3 product ids [10590,16773,7350] — zero overlap, pagination honored. perPage=36 (Klevu adapter default).
stageNotes.stage6_sort: NEWEST/NEWESTFIRST/NEWEST_FIRST/{field:date,direction:desc} all return HTTP 500 (Invalid request). Klevu category-page.js source contains only 3 sort enum values: RELEVANCE, PRICE_ASC, PRICE_DESC. Default order is RELEVANCE (not date-based — ids 10599->16368->17096 are non-monotonic). sortParam=null, sortVerified=false (no newest-first sort available).
stageNotes.stage7_watermark: full-catalog-sweep. Reason: no API date sort, no lastmod in product sitemap, no DOM-rendered sort dropdown, BC entity ids visible in Klevu records but not exposed as a sort key. Sweep via Klevu wildcard SEARCH with offset pagination is fast (5262/36 ~= 147 pages).
stageNotes.stage8_productCount: Sitemap count: 5262 (single page; page=2 -> 404). Klevu API totalResultsFound: 5262 — exact match. productCountMethod={method:'sitemap', url:'/xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1'}.
stageNotes.stage9_assembly: Validator-aligned shape. catalogUrls populated with 12 top-level slugs for compatibility with the operator-review pipeline; runtime adapter uses Klevu API globally.
